narratives.Description: chore(release): raise Windows Step 5 hang detector 45→60m for suite growth
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
After #5084/#5086/#5089, Windows `task release` Step 5 progresses but exceeds the 45m hang detector (`RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS`). Tee still wrote spawn-heavy timeline files when exit 124 fired. Suite growth: occupancy suites now complete instead of early hook-timeout skip.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Raise `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS` 45→60 minutes; update pin test + RELEASING.md / CHANGELOG.
- [ ] Deliberate gate change (same class as #5024).

Blocks 0.119.10.
